questions.q: The road is wide here, but it becomes ___ near the bridge.
questions.e: Narrow est le contraire de wide : étroit est le contraire de large.

questions.q: The classroom was noisy at lunch, but it became ___ when the lesson began.
questions.e: Quiet est le contraire de noisy : silencieux est le contraire de bruyant.

questions.q: The bottle is empty; now it is ___.
questions.e: Full est le contraire de empty : plein est le contraire de vide.

questions.q: We arrived early, but our friends arrived ___.
questions.e: Late est le contraire de early : en retard est le contraire d’en avance.

questions.q: The shop will increase its opening hours, not ___ them.
questions.e: Decrease est le contraire de increase : diminuer est le contraire d’augmenter.

questions.q: I remembered the address, but my brother ___ it.
questions.e: Forgot est le contraire de remembered : oublier est le contraire de se souvenir.

questions.q: A generous person shares; a ___ person keeps everything.
questions.e: Selfish est le contraire de generous dans ce contexte.

questions.q: The teacher will include this chapter, not ___ it.
questions.e: Exclude est le contraire de include : exclure est le contraire d’inclure.

questions.q: Mariam is patient with beginners, but her brother is ___.
questions.e: Impatient est le contraire de patient.

questions.q: The shallow end is safe for children; the other end is ___.
questions.e: Deep est le contraire de shallow : profond est le contraire de peu profond.

questions.q: This stone feels rough, but the table feels ___.
questions.e: Smooth est le contraire de rough : lisse est le contraire de rugueux.

questions.q: The museum displays local art, not ___ art.
questions.e: Foreign est le contraire de local dans ce contexte.

questions.q: The first street is narrow; the next one is ___.
questions.e: Wide est le contraire de narrow : large est le contraire d’étroit.

questions.q: At the end of the trip, the bus will depart; at the start, it will ___.
questions.e: Arrive est le contraire de depart : arriver est le contraire de partir.

questions.q: The new bridge is modern, while the old fort is ___.
questions.e: Ancient est le contraire de modern : ancien est le contraire de moderne.

questions.q: The first question is simple, but the last one is ___.
questions.e: Complicated est le contraire de simple dans ce contexte.

questions.q: The rope is strong, but this old thread is ___.
questions.e: Weak est le contraire de strong : faible est le contraire de fort.

questions.q: The school permit is temporary, but the house permit is ___.
questions.e: Permanent est le contraire de temporary.

questions.q: The meeting is public, but the staff room is ___.
questions.e: Private est le contraire de public.

questions.q: The water is fresh today, but it may become ___ if it is left out.
questions.e: Stale est le contraire de fresh pour la nourriture ou ce qui n’est plus frais.

questions.q: A polite reply is welcome; a ___ reply can hurt someone.
questions.e: Rude est le contraire de polite.

questions.q: This path is dangerous at night, but the main road is ___.
questions.e: Safe est le contraire de dangerous.

questions.q: The test was a success, but the first attempt was a ___.
questions.e: Failure est le contraire de success : échec est le contraire de réussite.

questions.q: The instructions say to accept the offer, not ___ it.
questions.e: Reject est le contraire de accept : refuser est le contraire d’accepter.
